post.description:
Context.dev Crawl Website

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
A request reference price is not currently available; use a request quote where supported. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de'). Must be one of Context.dev's supported countries.

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to remove before conversion. Applied after includeSelectors; exclusion wins on a double match.

followSubdomains.description: Follow links on subdomains of the starting URL's domain (e.g. docs.example.com from example.com). www and apex are always equivalent. Default false.

includeFrames.description: Render iframe contents into the output. Default false.

includeImages.description: Include image references in the Markdown output. Default false.

includeLinks.description: Preserve hyperlinks in the Markdown output. Default true.

includeSelectors.description: CSS selectors. When provided, only matching subtrees are kept before each page is converted to Markdown.

maxAgeMs.description: Reuse a cached result younger than this many milliseconds. Default 86400000 (1 day), max 2592000000 (30 days). Set 0 to always fetch fresh.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth from the starting URL (0 = only the starting page). Unlimited when omitted.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Default 100, hard cap 500. This is also what sizes the admission hold — one credit per page.

end.description: Last 1-based PDF page to parse. Must be >= start.

ocr.description: Detect and OCR images embedded in the selected PDF pages, inserting the recognized text in reading order. Default false. OCR calls cost more credits upstream.

shouldParse.description: Fetch and parse PDF pages. When false, PDFs are skipped entirely (not returned and not counted as failures). Default true.

settleAnimations.description: Wait briefly for animations to settle before capturing each page. Default false.

shortenBase64Images.description: Truncate inline base64 image payloads to keep the output small. Default true.

stopAfterMs.description: Soft time budget for the whole crawl in milliseconds (10000-110000, default 80000). When exceeded, the pages collected so far are returned instead of continuing.

timeoutMS.description: Upstream timeout in milliseconds (max 300000). Context.dev aborts the call with a 408 when exceeded. Keep it below the endpoint's requestTimeoutMs so the provider answers before the platform's own budget expires.

url.description: Starting URL for the crawl, including the http:// or https:// scheme.

urlRegex.description: Only URLs matching this pattern are followed and scraped.

useMainContentOnly.description: Keep only the page's main content, dropping headers, footers, sidebars, and navigation when detectable. Default false.

waitForMs.description: Extra browser wait in milliseconds after page load before the content is captured (0-30000). Useful for JavaScript-heavy pages.

zdr.description: Set 'enabled' to bypass Context.dev's shared caches and omit request and response content from its retained usage logs. Requires zero data retention on the Context.dev organization, otherwise the call fails with ZDR_NOT_ENABLED.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

settleAnimations.description: Wait briefly for animations to settle before each page is read. Default false.

stopAfterMs.description: Soft time budget for the crawl phase in milliseconds (10000-110000, default 80000).

timeoutMS.description: Upstream timeout in milliseconds (max 300000). Context.dev aborts the call with a 408 when exceeded. Keep it below the endpoint's requestTimeoutMs so the provider answers before the platform's own budget expires.

url.description: Starting website URL to crawl and extract from.

waitForMs.description: Extra browser wait in milliseconds after page load before the content is captured (0-30000). Useful for JavaScript-heavy pages.
